title.zh: 腾讯混元发布Hy Memory 2.0：模型、框架、应用三层全开源，开源记忆框架评测第一
title.en: 腾讯混元发布Hy Memory 2.0：模型、框架、应用三层全开源，开源记忆框架评测第一

current_state.zh: 腾讯混元已开源发布 Hy Memory 2.0，包含专用模型 Hy-Memory-30B-A3B、记忆框架和 MemHub 应用；2.0新增工作记忆与代码记忆（含Git回滚代码追溯），让10款AI编程工具共用本地记忆，并在四套记忆系统测试中以55.49平均分略高于 Opus 5 的54.62分。
current_state.en: Tencent Hunyuan has open-sourced Hy Memory 2.0, including the dedicated Hy-Memory-30B-A3B model, memory framework, and MemHub app; version 2.0 adds work and Git-linked code memory (including rollback tracing), lets 10 AI coding tools share a local memory store, and scored 55.49 average versus Opus 5's 54.62 on four memory benchmarks.

updates.title_zh: 腾讯混元发布Hy Memory 2.0：模型、框架、应用三层全开源，开源记忆框架评测第一
updates.title_en: 腾讯混元发布Hy Memory 2.0：模型、框架、应用三层全开源，开源记忆框架评测第一
updates.what_changed_zh: 腾讯混元发布 Hy Memory 2.0，全面开源专用记忆模型、记忆框架以及可连接 10 款 AI 工具的 MemHub 本地记忆应用，声称在 4 项基准测试中位居开源第一，并报告在腾讯自家产品中准确率大幅提升。
updates.what_changed_en: Tencent Hunyuan released Hy Memory 2.0, fully open-sourcing a dedicated memory model, the memory framework, and the MemHub local memory application that links to 10 AI tools, claiming top open-source ranking across 4 benchmarks and reporting large accuracy gains in Tencent's own products.
updates.current_state_zh: 腾讯混元发布 Hy Memory 2.0，全面开源专用记忆模型、记忆框架以及可连接 10 款 AI 工具的 MemHub 本地记忆应用，声称在 4 项基准测试中位居开源第一，并报告在腾讯自家产品中准确率大幅提升。
updates.current_state_en: Tencent Hunyuan released Hy Memory 2.0, fully open-sourcing a dedicated memory model, the memory framework, and the MemHub local memory application that links to 10 AI tools, claiming top open-source ranking across 4 benchmarks and reporting large accuracy gains in Tencent's own products.

updates.title_zh: 腾讯Hy Memory 2.0开源：10款AI工具共享记忆，连回滚过的代码都能追溯
updates.title_en: 腾讯Hy Memory 2.0开源：10款AI工具共享记忆，连回滚过的代码都能追溯
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增披露：Hy Memory 2.0新增工作记忆与代码记忆，可结合Git记录追踪文件和函数修改历史（包括回滚代码追溯）；专用模型为Hy-Memory-30B-A3B（总参数300亿，每次激活约30亿）；四套记忆系统测试平均55.49分，略高于Opus 5的54.62分；MemHub让Cursor、Codex、Claude Code等10款工具共用一份本地记忆。
updates.what_changed_en: New details disclosed: Hy Memory 2.0 adds work and Git-linked code memory, tracing file and function modification history including rolled-back code; the dedicated model is Hy-Memory-30B-A3B (30B total parameters, about 3B activated); on four memory system tests it averaged 55.49, slightly above Opus 5's 54.62; MemHub lets 10 tools including Cursor, Codex, and Claude Code share one local memory store.
updates.current_state_zh: 腾讯混元已开源发布 Hy Memory 2.0，包含专用模型 Hy-Memory-30B-A3B、记忆框架和 MemHub 应用；2.0新增工作记忆与代码记忆（含Git回滚代码追溯），让10款AI编程工具共用本地记忆，并在四套记忆系统测试中以55.49平均分略高于 Opus 5 的54.62分。
updates.current_state_en: Tencent Hunyuan has open-sourced Hy Memory 2.0, including the dedicated Hy-Memory-30B-A3B model, memory framework, and MemHub app; version 2.0 adds work and Git-linked code memory (including rollback tracing), lets 10 AI coding tools share a local memory store, and scored 55.49 average versus Opus 5's 54.62 on four memory benchmarks.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Tencent Hunyuan released Hy Memory 2.0 as open source, adding work and Git-linked code memory plus a dedicated Hy-Memory-30B-A3B model and the MemHub app that lets 10 AI coding tools share one local memory store.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Tencent Hunyuan released Hy Memory 2.0 as open source, adding work and Git-linked code memory plus a dedicated Hy-Memory-30B-A3B model and the MemHub app that lets 10 AI coding tools share one local memory store.
